note: A release-bundled snapshot of Dex's full capability surface across four classes (active-skill, mcp-server, scheduled-automation, system-engine). NOT the live signed catalogue; current as of source_release. Excludes the 16 vendor anthropic-* bundled skills and dormant role-activated skills, which are outside this snapshot's scope.

capabilities.title: Triage
capabilities.value: Routes orphaned inbox files and scattered tasks into the right project, person or goal; the core capture loop that turns a piling inbox into filed, actionable context.

capabilities.title: Process Meetings
capabilities.value: Turns synced meetings into updated person pages, extracted tasks and organized notes so meetings feed the whole system instead of sitting as dead transcripts.

capabilities.title: Meeting Closeout
capabilities.value: Locks decisions, actions, owners and personal commitments right after a meeting, before the freshest and highest-value moment evaporates.

capabilities.title: Save Insight
capabilities.value: Captures a reusable learning from completed work so hard-won knowledge compounds instead of being re-derived.

capabilities.title: Scrape
capabilities.value: Scrapes web pages on demand and pulls the result into the vault as capture material.

capabilities.title: Daily Plan
capabilities.value: Builds today's plan from calendar, tasks, priorities and commitments with scheduling suggestions; anchors every morning as the single most-used forcing function.

capabilities.title: Journal
capabilities.value: Toggles or starts a morning, evening or weekly journal entry, adding reflective grounding to the day for those who want it.

capabilities.title: Meeting Prep
capabilities.value: Gathers attendee context, history and related topics before a meeting, so every call starts warm instead of cold.

capabilities.title: Relationship Radar
capabilities.value: Ranks relationships going cold and important contacts slipping, catching silent relationship decay before it costs you.

capabilities.title: Commitments
capabilities.value: Reconciles promises made and asks received into owner, due date and source, then turns them into tracked tasks.

capabilities.title: Delegate Check
capabilities.value: Reviews open delegations — what was handed off, its status, and the next nudge — so handoffs stay accountable.

capabilities.title: Pipeline Sync
capabilities.value: Reconciles the live CRM pipeline against the local tracker and flags drift, keeping deal relationships trustworthy.

capabilities.title: Daily Review
capabilities.value: Closes the day with done-vs-planned, follow-ups and learnings, ending every day with synthesis instead of fog.

capabilities.title: Week Review
capabilities.value: Reviews the week with concrete accomplishments, patterns and goal tracking — a weekly signal without invented percentages.

capabilities.title: Weekly Reflection
capabilities.value: A short guided reflection on what energized or drained you, surfacing how the work felt and not just what shipped.

capabilities.title: Identity Snapshot
capabilities.value: Maintains a living profile of working patterns, decision tendencies and quality preferences, making your own patterns visible.

capabilities.title: Decision Log
capabilities.value: Captures a decision with its context, options considered, rationale and a review date, recovering the 'why' behind past calls.

capabilities.title: Industry Truths
capabilities.value: Records time-horizoned assumptions about the industry — today, six months, twelve months — to ground strategic thinking.

capabilities.title: Review
capabilities.value: Back-compat redirect from the old /review command to Daily Review.

capabilities.title: X-Ray
capabilities.value: Explains the context, MCP tools and hooks behind Dex's last response, teaching the user how the system worked.

capabilities.title: Project Health
capabilities.value: Scans active projects for status, blockers and next actions, catching stalls and quiet projects early.

capabilities.title: Week Plan
capabilities.value: Sets the week's priorities against goals, calendar shape and task effort, aligning the week to goals before it starts.

capabilities.title: Initiative Kickoff
capabilities.value: Turns a decision to start something into a real initiative and project page, cleanly launching new bets against pillars.

capabilities.title: Product Brief
capabilities.value: Extracts a product idea through guided questions and generates a written brief, turning an idea into a shippable spec.

capabilities.title: Setup
capabilities.value: First-time onboarding: builds the vault structure, profile and MCP configuration — the gateway that turns nothing into a working Dex.

capabilities.title: Getting Started
capabilities.value: A post-onboarding tour that adapts to existing data, turning a fresh vault into confident first use.

capabilities.title: Reset
capabilities.value: Restructures the vault for a new role without losing data, keeping Dex fitting your actual job over time.

capabilities.title: Manage Capabilities
capabilities.value: Turns optional rooms and features on or off without deleting content, trimming or extending the system to fit.

capabilities.title: Connect
capabilities.value: The front door to hundreds of app integrations, connectable locally and encrypted; the central hub for managing every connection.

capabilities.title: Google Workspace Setup
capabilities.value: Connects Gmail, Calendar and Docs for email-aware planning and meeting prep, unlocking email and calendar context across Dex.

capabilities.title: Granola Setup
capabilities.value: Connects Granola for automatic meeting sync and transcripts, feeding the meeting-processing engine without manual capture.

capabilities.title: Calendar Setup
capabilities.value: Grants direct calendar access for markedly faster queries, making calendar-driven planning fast.

capabilities.title: Zoom Setup
capabilities.value: Connects Zoom for recordings, scheduling and transcripts as another meeting-context source.

capabilities.title: Microsoft Teams Setup
capabilities.value: Connects Microsoft Teams for cross-channel meeting and comms context in MS-centric organizations.

capabilities.title: Apple Mail Setup
capabilities.value: Sets up and verifies Apple Mail search on macOS for email-aware capture.

capabilities.title: Atlassian Setup
capabilities.value: Connects Jira and Confluence for ticket tracking and knowledge search context.

capabilities.title: Pipedrive Setup
capabilities.value: Connects Pipedrive CRM for a live pipeline view and gated updates, enabling Pipeline Sync for sellers.

capabilities.title: Todoist Setup
capabilities.value: Connects Todoist two-way so tasks stay in sync with an external task tool.

capabilities.title: Things Setup
capabilities.value: Connects Things 3 on macOS so tasks stay in sync with an external task tool.

capabilities.title: Trello Setup
capabilities.value: Connects Trello boards and cards so tasks stay in sync with an external task tool.

capabilities.title: Obsidian Setup
capabilities.value: Enables Obsidian mode and converts links to wiki-link style, making the vault native to Obsidian users.

capabilities.title: Enable Semantic Search
capabilities.value: Turns on local meaning-based search over the vault so search finds what keyword matching misses.

capabilities.title: Dex Doctor
capabilities.value: A whole-system checkup that self-heals safe issues and guides the user through the rest, keeping the system honest and working.

capabilities.title: Dex Update
capabilities.value: Previews and safely adopts a Dex update with backup, apply, verify and rewind steps, removing the fear of breakage.

capabilities.title: Dex Rollback
capabilities.value: Rewinds one receipt-backed update instantly if it goes wrong.

capabilities.title: Dex What's New
capabilities.value: Shows recent improvements and new Claude capabilities, surfacing what changed.

capabilities.title: Dex Level Up
capabilities.value: Surfaces unused features based on observed usage patterns, discovering value already installed but untried.

capabilities.title: Dex Backlog
capabilities.value: Shows an AI-ranked backlog of system-improvement ideas, keeping them visible and prioritized.

capabilities.title: Dex Improve
capabilities.value: Workshops one backlog idea into a concrete implementation plan.

capabilities.title: Dex Orient
capabilities.value: Prints the released version, work merged but not yet released, and an architecture map for developers.

capabilities.title: Dex Add MCP
capabilities.value: Registers a known MCP server safely at user scope.

capabilities.title: Integrate MCP
capabilities.value: Installs and wires an existing off-the-shelf MCP server from Smithery or GitHub.

capabilities.title: Create MCP
capabilities.value: Builds a brand-new MCP integration through a guided wizard for a tool that has no server yet.

capabilities.title: Create Skill
capabilities.value: Authors a new Dex command skill that passes the quality bar, letting users extend Dex with their own workflows.

capabilities.title: Skill Score
capabilities.value: Grades an authored skill against the quality rubric with a ship-or-revise verdict.

capabilities.title: Prompt Improver
capabilities.value: Rewrites a vague prompt into a rich, structured one for better output.

capabilities.title: Feedback
capabilities.value: Investigates a Dex bug locally, builds a privacy-safe report, and tracks the resulting ticket to closure.

capabilities.title: Backup Setup
capabilities.value: Sets up automatic, verified vault backups with retention, protecting against losing your notes.

capabilities.title: Backup Now
capabilities.value: Runs a verified backup on demand, a snapshot before a big change.

capabilities.title: Backup Restore
capabilities.value: Verifies, proves and restores a backup without touching the live vault, proving backups actually work.

capabilities.title: Diff Generate
capabilities.value: Packages one workflow into a shareable document describing how you do a job.

capabilities.title: Diff Profile
capabilities.value: Packages your entire system into a shareable profile for others to adopt from.

capabilities.title: Diff Adopt
capabilities.value: Adopts one shared workflow, adapted to your own vault.

capabilities.title: Diff Adopt Profile
capabilities.value: Adopts a full published profile by handle, setting up your vault like a named person's.

capabilities.title: Diff List
capabilities.value: Lists workflows adopted from others.

capabilities.title: Diff Remove
capabilities.value: Removes an adopted workflow, leaving the vault's own data intact.

capabilities.title: Work MCP server
capabilities.value: The deterministic spine of Dex — tasks, goals, priorities, the people/company index, meeting context and capacity scheduling. Nearly every planning skill calls it.

capabilities.title: Calendar MCP server
capabilities.value: The bridge to Apple Calendar and two-way iOS Reminders task sync.

capabilities.title: Onboarding MCP server
capabilities.value: Runs one-time vault setup, first-week analysis and entity-page offers; high value once, then dormant.

capabilities.title: Resume MCP server
capabilities.value: A guided resume and LinkedIn builder with metric and length validation, used episodically.

capabilities.title: Improvements MCP server
capabilities.value: The self-evolution engine — idea backlog, changelog and learning synthesis, redundancy validation.

capabilities.title: Career MCP server
capabilities.value: Evidence scanning, ladder parsing, coverage analysis and a 0-100 promotion-readiness score.

capabilities.title: Session Memory MCP server
capabilities.value: Cross-session recall of decisions, observations, entity timelines and tool-usage history.

capabilities.title: Customization Carryover MCP server
capabilities.value: Safely carries user customizations across Dex Core upgrades through staged, reviewable capsules.

capabilities.title: Granola MCP server
capabilities.value: The meeting-transcript source of record, feeding both capture and relationship tracking.

capabilities.title: Analytics MCP server
capabilities.value: Opt-in, consent-gated local usage analytics.

capabilities.title: Meeting intelligence sync
capabilities.value: Silently pulls meetings into the vault on a fixed interval — the always-on engine behind meeting capture.

capabilities.title: Changelog checker
capabilities.value: Background self-improvement watcher that alerts on new Claude Code features as they ship.

capabilities.title: Learning review nudge
capabilities.value: An evening nudge to review pending session learnings before they pile up.

capabilities.title: Nightly smoke test
capabilities.value: An opt-in nightly health and smoke test of the vault.

capabilities.title: Vault backup
capabilities.value: Runs a verified, retained vault backup on a daily schedule without user action, the engine behind Backup Setup.

capabilities.title: Vault brain architecture
capabilities.value: The PARA-derived folder system functions as a cognitive architecture, not storage: capture routing reads Week Priorities and Quarter Goals live and boosts confidence on strategic match, letting a stray thought find its own home.

capabilities.title: Instinct-layer trigger routing
capabilities.value: Natural-language reflexes with no slash command: an idea offhandedly mentioned is captured to the backlog, a defect report is routed differently from a wish, and casual task-completion language is matched and applied.

capabilities.title: Planning hierarchy as connected memory
capabilities.value: Quarter Goals, Week Priorities, Daily Plan and Tasks form one strategic spine every subsystem reads; archived plans give the morning brief a longitudinal record to trend against.

capabilities.title: Session-start context injection
capabilities.value: On every session start, goals, priorities, urgent tasks, health status and unprocessed-meeting notices are loaded deterministically before the user types a word.

capabilities.title: People and company relationship memory
capabilities.value: One aggregated page per person and per organization — meeting history, what they care about, open actions — the substrate that lets you never walk in cold.

capabilities.title: Silent context-injector hooks
capabilities.value: Relevant person and company context is injected ambiently whenever any file mentioning them is read — no header, no command, no request needed.

capabilities.title: Entity engine
capabilities.value: Deterministic attendee tracking across meeting sync; promotes a contact to a full page once eligibility rules are met, honoring an automatic, suggested or off creation mode.

capabilities.title: Relationship cooling radar
capabilities.value: Learns each relationship's natural contact cadence and flags people going cold relative to how often you actually talk. Relationship-decay memory.

capabilities.title: Tasks as a single source of truth
capabilities.value: One task ledger with stable IDs, cross-referenced into person, company, project and meeting pages so status never drifts between views.

capabilities.title: Soft-promise detector
capabilities.value: Catches implicit commitments in what you type — 'I'll follow up with Sarah', 'I owe you' — and offers a one-time capture, turning casual promises into tracked tasks.

capabilities.title: Learnings library
capabilities.value: Mistake patterns and working preferences compound into a standing memory that surfaces rules to prevent repeating the same missteps.

capabilities.title: Proactive Health
capabilities.value: Dex monitors its own reliability — a promise register that distinguishes 'running' from 'succeeding' and surfaces failures mid-session.

capabilities.title: Ritual intelligence engine
capabilities.value: A local-first runtime detects recurring meetings as tracked rituals and deterministically generates prep briefs carrying continuity from the previous session.

capabilities.title: Career evidence capture
capabilities.value: Detects candidate career evidence with provenance as a side effect of normal work and offers it for confirmation, accreting a compounding case for promotion.

capabilities.title: Backlog self-ranking
capabilities.value: Captured improvement ideas are ranked on weighted dimensions including whether the system gets smarter and more anticipatory from each one — the system reasoning about its own proactivity.
